changelog: 1.0.0 - Initial 60 cases: 16 billing, 16 technical, 16 account, 12 general, ~40% edge cases.

input.text: Hello, I was charged Rs 1,499 twice on 3rd October for the Pro plan. My bank statement shows both transactions. Please refund the duplicate charge.

expected.summary: Customer was charged twice for the Pro plan and wants the duplicate refunded.

cases.notes: Classic double charge, the most common billing ticket.

input.text: Can you send me a GST invoice for my last three payments? Our finance team needs them for the quarterly filing.

expected.summary: Customer needs GST invoices for their last three payments.

cases.notes: Invoice request with no complaint attached.

input.text: I cancelled my subscription on the 1st but you still took money on the 5th. I want that refund today.

expected.summary: Customer was charged after cancelling and wants a refund.

cases.notes: Mentions cancellation (could look like account) but the ask is money back.

input.text: My credit card was declined when I tried to renew. The card works everywhere else. What is going on?

expected.summary: Customer's card is being declined on renewal even though it works elsewhere.

cases.notes: Payment failure; a model might call this technical.

input.text: What will it cost to move from 5 seats to 12 seats on the Team plan? Is there a discount for annual billing?

expected.summary: Customer wants the price for upgrading from 5 to 12 seats and asks about annual discounts.

cases.notes: Pricing question, should not fall into general.

input.text: The coupon code DIWALI25 says it is invalid at checkout. Your email said it is valid till the 31st.

expected.summary: Customer's DIWALI25 coupon is rejected at checkout despite being advertised as valid.

cases.notes: Coupon failing at checkout: billing outcome, technical symptom.

input.text: refund pls

expected.summary: Customer is asking for a refund.

cases.notes: Two words. Tests that the model does not panic on tiny inputs.

input.text: i got chargd 3 tims this mnth for the same plan wtf is happening with ur billing

expected.summary: Customer was charged three times this month for the same plan.

cases.notes: Heavy typos plus frustration. Intent is still clear.

input.text: Wow, amazing. You raised my price by 40% with zero warning. Truly the customer-first company you claim to be. Explain this charge.

expected.summary: Customer is upset about an unannounced 40% price increase and wants an explanation.

cases.notes: Sarcastic tone; positive words ('amazing') must not pull it to general.

input.text: Bhai mera payment do baar cut gaya hai, please ek refund kar do. Order ID 88231.

expected.summary: Customer was charged twice for order 88231 and wants one payment refunded.

cases.notes: Hinglish. Tests multilingual robustness on a common Indian support pattern.

input.text: Our company switched to a new card. How do I update the payment method so next month's renewal doesn't fail?

expected.summary: Customer wants to update their payment card before the next renewal.

cases.notes: Updating payment details is account-settings-like, but it is about paying.

input.text: Why does my invoice show 18% tax? We are a registered business outside India.

expected.summary: Customer questions the 18% tax on their invoice as a foreign registered business.

cases.notes: Tax question; needs domain knowledge that tax is billing.

input.text: The app crashed during checkout and now I see a charge but no upgrade. Please either refund or activate my plan.

expected.summary: Customer was charged during a crashed checkout but did not get the upgrade.

cases.notes: Crash plus charge. Prompt v1.1.0 tie-break says money wins, but technical is defensible.

input.text: Hola, me cobraron dos veces este mes. Can you refund one of the charges please?

expected.summary: Customer was charged twice this month and wants one refunded.

cases.notes: Spanish + English code switch.

input.text: Is there a student discount? I'm at university and the monthly price is steep for me.

expected.summary: Customer is asking whether a student discount is available.

cases.notes: Discount enquiry; could drift to general.

input.text: Please cancel the auto-renewal and confirm I will not be charged again next year.

expected.summary: Customer wants auto-renewal cancelled and confirmation of no future charges.

cases.notes: Auto-renew is both an account setting and a billing control.

input.text: The mobile app crashes every time I open the Reports tab. Android 14, app version 5.2.1.

expected.summary: Customer's Android app crashes when opening the Reports tab on version 5.2.1.

cases.notes: Clean crash report with device details.

input.text: CSV export is broken. The file downloads but it is empty, 0 KB.

expected.summary: Customer's CSV export downloads as an empty file.

cases.notes: Broken feature, clear technical.

input.text: Your API is returning 502 errors on /v2/orders since about 2pm IST. Our integration is down.

expected.summary: Customer's integration is failing because the /v2/orders API returns 502 errors.

cases.notes: API outage report from a developer customer.

input.text: Notifications stopped working on iPhone after the last update. I miss every new message now.

expected.summary: Customer stopped receiving iPhone notifications after the latest update.

cases.notes: Post-update regression report.

input.text: Pages take 20+ seconds to load, it's unusable. Our internet is fine, other sites are fast.

expected.summary: Customer reports pages taking over 20 seconds to load.

cases.notes: Performance complaint without an explicit error message.

input.text: sync isnt workng between my laptop and phone, changes on one dont show on the other

expected.summary: Customer's data is not syncing between their laptop and phone.

cases.notes: Typos in core keywords (workng).

input.text: Error 0x80041 when uploading files bigger than 10MB.

expected.summary: Customer gets error 0x80041 when uploading files over 10MB.

cases.notes: Short, jargon-heavy, no greeting.

input.text: Oh great, the dashboard is blank AGAIN. Third time this week. Love paying for software that doesn't load.

expected.summary: Customer's dashboard is blank again for the third time this week.

cases.notes: Sarcasm mentions paying; should stay technical, not billing.

input.text: Google Calendar integration stopped pulling events since yesterday. Reconnecting did not help.

expected.summary: Customer's Google Calendar integration stopped syncing events and reconnecting did not fix it.

cases.notes: Integration failure.

input.text: app band ho jata hai jab main photo upload karta hoon. Please fix karo.

expected.summary: Customer's app closes when they upload a photo.

cases.notes: Hinglish crash report; few English keywords.

input.text: The search bar returns no results even for invoices I can see in the list.

expected.summary: Customer's search returns no results for invoices that clearly exist.

cases.notes: Mentions invoices but the problem is broken search. Keyword trap for billing.

input.text: 2FA codes from your app are always rejected as expired, even when I enter them immediately.

expected.summary: Customer's 2FA codes are rejected as expired even when entered right away.

cases.notes: Could be account (login) or technical (time-sync bug). Both acceptable.

input.text: broken

expected.summary: Customer reports that something is broken.

cases.notes: One word. The only sensible guess is technical.

input.text: Dark mode makes all the chart labels invisible. Screenshot attached.

expected.summary: Customer reports chart labels are invisible in dark mode.

cases.notes: UI bug, no error words like crash or error.

input.text: Webhooks are firing twice for every event, so our system creates duplicate orders.

expected.summary: Customer's webhooks fire twice per event, creating duplicate orders.

cases.notes: 'Duplicate orders' sounds like billing but it is a webhook bug.

input.text: The page freezes when I click Save on a long form, and I lose everything I typed.

expected.summary: Customer's page freezes on Save for long forms and their input is lost.

cases.notes: Freeze plus data loss.

input.text: I forgot my password and the reset link has expired. Can you send a new one?

expected.summary: Customer needs a new password reset link because the old one expired.

cases.notes: Standard password reset.

input.text: I'm locked out after too many login attempts. How long until I can try again?

expected.summary: Customer is locked out after failed logins and wants to know when they can retry.

cases.notes: Lockout question.

input.text: Please change the email on my account from rohan.k@oldmail.com to rohan@newco.in.

expected.summary: Customer wants to change their account email address.

cases.notes: Profile change request.

input.text: How do I delete my account and all my data permanently?

expected.summary: Customer wants to permanently delete their account and data.

cases.notes: Deletion request; privacy-relevant.

input.text: Need to add two new team members to our workspace and remove one who left the company.

expected.summary: Customer wants to add two team members and remove one from their workspace.

cases.notes: Seat management is account, though seats can cost money.

input.text: cant login

expected.summary: Customer cannot log in.

cases.notes: Two words, no apostrophe. Could be read as a bug.

input.text: i chnaged my phone and now i dont get the two factor code anymore how do i get bak in

expected.summary: Customer changed phones and no longer gets 2FA codes, so cannot log in.

cases.notes: Typos plus 2FA recovery.

input.text: Can I change my username? It still shows my old company name.

expected.summary: Customer wants to change their username from their old company name.

cases.notes: Simple profile change.

input.text: Fantastic, I've only requested a password reset five times and still nothing in my inbox. Brilliant system.

expected.summary: Customer has requested a password reset five times without receiving the email.

cases.notes: Sarcastic praise words; intent is account recovery.

input.text: Mera account login nahi ho raha, password bhi reset kar diya phir bhi. Help.

expected.summary: Customer still cannot log in even after resetting their password.

cases.notes: Hinglish login problem.

input.text: Someone logged into my account from another country. I did not do this. Please secure my account.

expected.summary: Customer reports an unknown login from another country and wants their account secured.

cases.notes: Security incident; must be routed fast.

input.text: How do I transfer ownership of the workspace to my colleague before I leave the company?

expected.summary: Customer wants to transfer workspace ownership to a colleague.

cases.notes: Ownership transfer; less common phrasing.

input.text: Login page says 'invalid credentials' but I'm 100% sure the password is right, I just reset it.

expected.summary: Customer gets an invalid credentials error right after resetting their password.

cases.notes: Error message present (technical signal) but it is an access issue.

input.text: Bonjour, I need to update my profile name, I recently got married. Merci!

expected.summary: Customer wants to update their profile name after getting married.

cases.notes: French greetings around an English request.

input.text: Please merge my two accounts, I accidentally signed up twice with different emails.

expected.summary: Customer wants to merge two accounts created with different emails.

cases.notes: Duplicate account merge.

input.text: Can you turn off the 'remember me' setting for all users in our org? Security policy.

expected.summary: Customer wants 'remember me' disabled for all users in their organisation.

cases.notes: Org-wide account settings phrased as a policy request.

input.text: Do you have an office in Bengaluru? I'd like to visit for a demo.

expected.summary: Customer asks if there is a Bengaluru office to visit for a demo.

cases.notes: Plain general enquiry.

input.text: Just wanted to say your support team was amazing last week. Priya solved everything in 10 minutes!

expected.summary: Customer is complimenting the support team for quick help.

cases.notes: Pure praise; contrast with the sarcasm cases.

input.text: It would be great if you added a Kanban view. We'd use it every day.

expected.summary: Customer is requesting a Kanban view feature.

cases.notes: Feature request, not a bug.

input.text: Are you hiring interns for the summer? I'm a CS student.

expected.summary: Customer asks whether summer internships are available.

cases.notes: Careers enquiry.

input.text: We're a fintech startup and would love to explore a partnership or integration deal.

expected.summary: Customer is interested in exploring a partnership with the company.

cases.notes: Mentions integration (technical keyword) but it is a business enquiry.

input.text: What are your support hours on weekends?

expected.summary: Customer asks about weekend support hours.

cases.notes: Simple information question.

input.text: hi

expected.summary: Customer sent a greeting with no request.

cases.notes: No content at all. Only general makes sense.

input.text: Do you have documentation on how the reports feature works? I couldn't find a guide.

expected.summary: Customer is looking for documentation on the reports feature.

cases.notes: Docs question; 'reports' might pull toward technical.

input.text: Kya aap log Hindi mein bhi support dete ho? Mere parents ko use karna hai.

expected.summary: Customer asks whether support is available in Hindi for their parents.

cases.notes: Hinglish general question.

input.text: Is your product GDPR compliant? Our legal team is asking before we sign.

expected.summary: Customer asks whether the product is GDPR compliant before signing.

cases.notes: Compliance question from a prospect.

input.text: Yeah sure, keep sending me 4 marketing emails a day, that's totally what I signed up for.

expected.summary: Customer is sarcastically complaining about receiving too many marketing emails.

cases.notes: Could be account (email preferences). General or account both fine.

input.text: Can I use your product for a non-profit? We run a small NGO in Jaipur.

expected.summary: Customer asks whether the product can be used by their small NGO.

cases.notes: Might drift to billing if the model assumes they want a discount.
